summary.en: The crust is Earth’s thin rocky outer layer.
summary.zh: 地壳是地球外面很薄的岩石层。

detail.en: This shell uses a uniform land-crust example of about 30 km; real crust varies in thickness. Oceanic crust can be much thinner. [S59, S63]
detail.zh: 这个薄壳采用约30千米的均匀陆壳示例；真实地壳厚薄不同，海洋地壳可以薄得多。[S59, S63]

summary.en: The mantle is mostly solid rock beneath the crust.
summary.zh: 地幔在地壳下方，大部分是固态岩石。

detail.en: Rock here can deform over geological time. The thick rocky shell is not a global sea of magma. Its radial extent is a teaching synthesis of the cited Earth measurements. [S6, S58, S59, S63]
detail.zh: 这里的岩石能在地质时间尺度上变形。这个厚岩石壳不是全球岩浆海；其半径范围由所引地球数值拼合成教学几何。[S6, S58, S59, S63]

summary.en: Liquid metal surrounds the solid inner core.
summary.zh: 液态金属包围着固态内核。

detail.en: The outer core is liquid metal, represented by a closed shell rather than flowing light. Its outer boundary is about 3,485 km from Earth’s centre. It does not supply a volcano’s magma. [S58, S59, S10, S63]
detail.zh: 外核是液态金属；模型用闭合壳表示，不用流光表示液态。其外边界离地心约3485千米。它不为火山供给岩浆。[S58, S59, S10, S63]

summary.en: The inner core is solid metal at Earth’s centre.
summary.zh: 内核是地心的固态金属。

detail.en: The inner-core boundary has a radius of about 1,221 km. A solid half-sphere exposes the centre. Radius means centre to boundary, not the distance across the whole core. [S59, S63]
detail.zh: 内核边界半径约1221千米。实心半球露出中心；半径是中心到边界的距离，不是穿过整个内核的距离。[S59, S63]

summary.en: This layer moves with the rest of the lithospheric plate.
summary.zh: 这一层与岩石圈板块的其余部分一起移动。

detail.en: A plate includes crust and rigid uppermost mantle. This separate sample enlarges thin layers; its drawn thicknesses are design values, not Earth-scale measurements. [S6, S7, S63]
detail.zh: 板块包括地壳和刚性的最上部地幔。这个独立小样放大薄层；所画厚度是设计值，不按地球比例量取。[S6, S7, S63]

summary.en: This layer moves with the rest of the lithospheric plate.
summary.zh: 这一层与岩石圈板块的其余部分一起移动。

detail.en: A plate includes crust and rigid uppermost mantle. This separate sample enlarges thin layers; its drawn thicknesses are design values, not Earth-scale measurements. [S6, S7, S63]
detail.zh: 板块包括地壳和刚性的最上部地幔。这个独立小样放大薄层；所画厚度是设计值，不按地球比例量取。[S6, S7, S63]

summary.en: The mantle below the plate remains mostly solid.
summary.zh: 板块下方的地幔仍大部分是固态。

detail.en: A plate includes crust and rigid uppermost mantle. This separate sample enlarges thin layers; its drawn thicknesses are design values, not Earth-scale measurements. [S6, S7, S63]
detail.zh: 板块包括地壳和刚性的最上部地幔。这个独立小样放大薄层；所画厚度是设计值，不按地球比例量取。[S6, S7, S63]

summary.en: Separating plates allow magma to rise and make new oceanic crust.
summary.zh: 板块分开时，岩浆可上升形成新海洋地壳。

detail.en: Each complete block includes crust and rigid uppermost mantle. The local shape and accelerated movement are schematic, without geographical coordinates. [S7, S45, S63]
detail.zh: 每块完整板块包括地壳和刚性的最上部地幔。局部形状与加速运动均为示意，没有地理坐标。[S7, S45, S63]

summary.en: Separating plates allow magma to rise and make new oceanic crust.
summary.zh: 板块分开时，岩浆可上升形成新海洋地壳。

detail.en: Each complete block includes crust and rigid uppermost mantle. The local shape and accelerated movement are schematic, without geographical coordinates. [S7, S45, S63]
detail.zh: 每块完整板块包括地壳和刚性的最上部地幔。局部形状与加速运动均为示意，没有地理坐标。[S7, S45, S63]

name.zh: 进入俯冲区的海洋板块

summary.en: The incoming plate continues into the descending slab.
summary.zh: 进入俯冲区的板块与下降板片连续相接。

detail.en: Each complete block includes crust and rigid uppermost mantle. The local shape and accelerated movement are schematic, without geographical coordinates. [S7, S45, S63]
detail.zh: 每块完整板块包括地壳和刚性的最上部地幔。局部形状与加速运动均为示意，没有地理坐标。[S7, S45, S63]

summary.en: This continuous slab descends into the mantle.
summary.zh: 这块连续的板片向地幔下降。

detail.en: The slab meets the incoming plate along the same full cross-section. Water carried by subducting rock helps rock above it melt partly; the slab is not drawn as a pipe from the core. [S7, S9, S63]
detail.zh: 板片沿相同完整截面接上进入区的板块。俯冲岩石所带的水有助于上方岩石部分熔融；板片不是来自地核的管道。[S7, S9, S63]

summary.en: The overriding plate sits above the descending slab.
summary.zh: 上覆板块位于下降板片上方。

detail.en: Each complete block includes crust and rigid uppermost mantle. The local shape and accelerated movement are schematic, without geographical coordinates. [S7, S45, S63]
detail.zh: 每块完整板块包括地壳和刚性的最上部地幔。局部形状与加速运动均为示意，没有地理坐标。[S7, S45, S63]

summary.en: Water from the slab helps some rock above it melt.
summary.zh: 板片释放的水有助于上方部分岩石熔融。

detail.en: This small highlighted region represents local partial melting, not a mantle-wide molten layer. Its size is enlarged for reading. [S9, S63]
detail.zh: 这块小区域表示局部部分熔融，不是遍布地幔的熔融层。大小为便于阅读而放大。[S9, S63]

summary.en: This plate slides horizontally past its neighbour.
summary.zh: 这块板块沿水平方向错过相邻板块。

detail.en: Each complete block includes crust and rigid uppermost mantle. The local shape and accelerated movement are schematic, without geographical coordinates. [S7, S45, S63]
detail.zh: 每块完整板块包括地壳和刚性的最上部地幔。局部形状与加速运动均为示意，没有地理坐标。[S7, S45, S63]

summary.en: This plate slides horizontally past its neighbour.
summary.zh: 这块板块沿水平方向错过相邻板块。

detail.en: Each complete block includes crust and rigid uppermost mantle. The local shape and accelerated movement are schematic, without geographical coordinates. [S7, S45, S63]
detail.zh: 每块完整板块包括地壳和刚性的最上部地幔。局部形状与加速运动均为示意，没有地理坐标。[S7, S45, S63]

summary.en: Converging continents can build mountains.
summary.zh: 大陆靠近碰撞可以形成山脉。

detail.en: This separate convergence sample compares continental collision with oceanic subduction. It does not assume the same volcanic arrangement. The folds and thickness are schematic. [S7, S63]
detail.zh: 这个独立汇聚小样把大陆碰撞与海洋板块俯冲并列比较，不假定两者具有相同的火山排列。褶皱与厚度为示意。[S7, S63]

summary.en: Rock builds the cone around a surface opening.
summary.zh: 岩石围着地表开口形成火山锥。

detail.en: This cone is a teaching cutaway with one top opening. Its slopes and layers are schematic, not the dimensions of a named volcano. [S10, S63]
detail.zh: 这是一个顶部只有一个开口的教学剖面。坡度和岩层均为示意，不是某座火山的尺寸。[S10, S63]

summary.en: Solid rock surrounds the local magma system.
summary.zh: 固态围岩包围着局部岩浆系统。

detail.en: The cut rock surrounds a shaped storage region. The teaching section ends locally below it; no conduit leads down to the core. [S10, S63]
detail.zh: 切开的围岩围绕着储存区。教学剖面在其下方的局部范围结束，没有通向地核的通道。[S10, S63]

summary.en: Magma collects locally with crystals in the storage region.
summary.zh: 岩浆与晶体在局部储存区共存。

detail.en: Storage can contain melt and crystals together. The small pale crystals and the cut surface are enlarged symbols; the region is not an empty cave or the core. [S10, S63]
detail.zh: 储存区可以同时含熔体与晶体。浅色小晶体和切面是放大的示意；这里不是空洞，也不是地核。[S10, S63]

summary.en: This passage connects local magma storage to the opening.
summary.zh: 这条通道把局部岩浆储存区接到喷发口。

detail.en: The solid filled passage joins the storage body and the top vent. Real volcanic plumbing can be more complex; this path is local and does not connect to the core. [S10, S63]
detail.zh: 填满物质的通道接上储存区与顶部喷发口。真实火山管道可能更复杂；本通道限于局部，不连接地核。[S10, S63]

summary.en: Gas, fragments or lava can reach the surface at this opening.
summary.zh: 气体、碎屑或熔岩可从这个开口到达地表。

detail.en: The annular rim marks the same single top opening as the cone and conduit. It is an opening, not an extra underground chamber. [S10, S63]
detail.zh: 环形边缘标出火山锥与通道的同一个顶部开口；它是开口，不是额外的地下空腔。[S10, S63]

summary.en: Gas can form expanding bubbles as magma rises and pressure falls.
summary.zh: 岩浆上升、压力降低时，气体可析出并形成膨胀气泡。

detail.en: The pale bubbles are enlarged and repeated only for visibility. Their number and pose do not calculate gas pressure or an eruption threshold. [S10, S63]
detail.zh: 浅色气泡只为看清而放大重复。数量与姿态不计算气体压力，也不计算喷发门槛。[S10, S63]

summary.en: Magma that reaches the surface is called lava.
summary.zh: 岩浆喷到地表后叫熔岩。

detail.en: This small slope sample is kept beside the ash sample for comparison. It shows a path, not a forecast of how far a real lava flow would travel. [S10, S45, S63]
detail.zh: 这件小型坡面样本与火山灰并列供比较。它表示路径，不预测真实熔岩流能走多远。[S10, S45, S63]

summary.en: Volcanic ash consists of small rock, mineral and glass fragments.
summary.zh: 火山灰由细小岩石、矿物与玻璃碎屑组成。

detail.en: The fragments here are greatly enlarged. Under the definition used by this topic, ash is less than 2 mm in diameter. This comparison sample remains visible alongside lava and is not a simulated eruption cloud. [S65, S63]
detail.zh: 这里的碎屑大大放大。本题采用的定义为直径小于2毫米。这个比较样本与熔岩同时可见，不是模拟喷发云。[S65, S63]

summary.en: Rock stores elastic strain before sudden fault slip.
summary.zh: 断层突然滑动前，岩石储存弹性应变能。

detail.en: The sample shows horizontal offset and has no magma. The enlarged poses illustrate deformation followed by slip; they cannot predict an earthquake’s place or time. [S6, S12, S63]
detail.zh: 小样表示水平错距，不含岩浆。放大姿态表示先变形再滑动，不能预测地震的地点或时刻。[S6, S12, S63]

summary.en: Rock stores elastic strain before sudden fault slip.
summary.zh: 断层突然滑动前，岩石储存弹性应变能。

detail.en: The sample shows horizontal offset and has no magma. The enlarged poses illustrate deformation followed by slip; they cannot predict an earthquake’s place or time. [S6, S12, S63]
detail.zh: 小样表示水平错距，不含岩浆。放大姿态表示先变形再滑动，不能预测地震的地点或时刻。[S6, S12, S63]

summary.en: This surface marker makes bending and offset visible.
summary.zh: 地表标记让变形与错距可见。

detail.en: This coloured marker is a diagram device, not a separate geological layer. In the loaded pose each arm pivots about its contact end; slip then leaves a visible sideways mismatch. [S12, S63]
detail.zh: 这条有色标记是图解工具，不是独立地层。受力姿态中，两臂各绕接触端转动；滑动后保留可见的水平错距。[S12, S63]

summary.en: The contact stays locked while the outer marker arms turn.
summary.zh: 外侧标记臂偏转时，接触段保持锁定。

detail.en: This coloured marker is a diagram device, not a separate geological layer. In the loaded pose each arm pivots about its contact end; slip then leaves a visible sideways mismatch. [S12, S63]
detail.zh: 这条有色标记是图解工具，不是独立地层。受力姿态中，两臂各绕接触端转动；滑动后保留可见的水平错距。[S12, S63]

summary.en: This surface marker makes bending and offset visible.
summary.zh: 地表标记让变形与错距可见。

detail.en: This coloured marker is a diagram device, not a separate geological layer. In the loaded pose each arm pivots about its contact end; slip then leaves a visible sideways mismatch. [S12, S63]
detail.zh: 这条有色标记是图解工具，不是独立地层。受力姿态中，两臂各绕接触端转动；滑动后保留可见的水平错距。[S12, S63]

summary.en: The earthquake rupture starts at the focus.
summary.zh: 地震破裂从震源开始。

detail.en: The small sphere marks one starting location inside the fault, not the whole fault plane. Its size is enlarged. [S12, S63]
detail.zh: 小球标出断层内部的一个破裂起点，不代表整个断层面；大小经过放大。[S12, S63]

summary.en: The epicentre is on the surface directly above the focus.
summary.zh: 震中位于震源正上方的地表。

detail.en: This disc is vertically above the focus sphere. It does not mark the place that must shake most strongly. [S12, S63]
detail.zh: 这个圆盘在震源小球垂直上方，不表示那里一定震得最强。[S12, S63]

summary.en: This rock marker moves parallel to the wave’s travel direction.
summary.zh: 这枚岩石标记沿波传播的方向振动。

detail.en: The marker oscillates near its resting place instead of travelling with the wavefront. This P row is a separate comparison model. Position, amplitude, frequency and drawing speed are design values; du means diagram units, not metres. [S60, S63]
detail.zh: 标记在原位附近往返，不随波前一路前进。P波这一排是独立的比较模型。位置、振幅、频率与绘图速度都是设计值；du表示图解单位，不是米。[S60, S63]

summary.en: This rock marker moves parallel to the wave’s travel direction.

detail.en: The marker oscillates near its resting place instead of travelling with the wavefront. This P row is a separate comparison model. Position, amplitude, frequency and drawing speed are design values; du means diagram units, not metres. [S60, S63]
detail.zh: 标记在原位附近往返，不随波前一路前进。P波这一排是独立的比较模型。位置、振幅、频率与绘图速度都是设计值；du表示图解单位，不是米。[S60, S63]

summary.en: Sudden vertical seafloor movement can displace the water above.
summary.zh: 海床突然垂直移动，可以移开上方海水。

detail.en: In this example the central block rises and neighbouring blocks settle. The source switch turns off this example only; it does not exclude landslides or volcanic tsunami sources. [S13, S14, S63]
detail.zh: 本例中心块上升，相邻块下移。关闭源开关只表示本例无源，不排除滑坡或火山过程产生海啸。[S13, S14, S63]

summary.en: This depth marker represents disturbance through the water depth.
summary.zh: 这枚水深标记表示扰动涉及整个水深。

detail.en: The line and its two dots are one selectable symbol, not a to-scale water column. Vertical offsets are balanced diagram snapshots, not a calculation of currents, energy, flooding or real arrival time. [S15, S63]
detail.zh: 细线与上下两点合为一枚可选符号，不是按实尺画的水柱。上下位移是保持正负平衡的图解快照，不计算洋流、能量、淹没或真实到时。[S15, S63]

summary.en: A long wave slows in shallower water and its height may grow.
summary.zh: 长波进入浅水后减速，波高可能增加。

detail.en: This independent shore sample contrasts a longer, lower profile with a shorter, taller one. The shallow pose enlarges the drawn vertical shape only. The speed formula does not calculate wave height, inundation or a breaking wave. [S15, S63]
detail.zh: 这个独立近岸小样比较较长较低与较短较高的波形。浅水姿态只放大所画的竖向形状。速度公式不计算波高、淹没或卷浪。[S15, S63]

summary.en: Moving ground supplies the motion at the foundation.
summary.zh: 移动的地面把运动传到基础。

detail.en: This is a generic ground sample with no fault beneath it. Ground conditions help determine how shaking affects a structure. It is not a Singapore soil survey. [S25, S63]
detail.zh: 这是通用地面小样，下方不画断层。地面条件会影响结构对震动的响应；它不是新加坡土层勘测。[S25, S63]

summary.en: The foundation connects the structure to the ground.
summary.zh: 基础把结构连接到地面。

detail.en: The foundation depth and width are design choices. This sample has no default isolation device, specified piles or building-code parameters. It does not assess an actual building. [S25, S63]
detail.zh: 基础深度和宽度是设计选择。本样本没有默认隔震装置、指定桩基或建筑规范参数，不评估真实建筑。[S25, S63]

summary.en: Connected beams and columns support this generic structure.
summary.zh: 相连的梁柱支撑这件通用结构。

detail.en: This open frame lets the connections be seen. Its dimensions and exaggerated movement are diagram design, not an HDB drawing or measured Singapore building. Correct connections and suitable bracing matter. [S25, S63]
detail.zh: 开放框架让连接位置可见。尺寸与放大运动均为图解设计，不是HDB图纸或新加坡某栋楼的实测。正确连接与合适支撑很重要。[S25, S63]

summary.en: Floor slabs connect to the frame and structural wall in this sample.
summary.zh: 本样本的楼板与框架和结构墙相连。

detail.en: The repeated floors are design geometry, not a claim about a real building’s storey count. The floor, frame and wall share the same pose pivot so the connections stay together. [S25, S63]
detail.zh: 重复楼板是设计几何，不表示真实建筑的楼层数。楼板、框架和结构墙共用姿态枢轴，使连接保持相接。[S25, S63]

summary.en: This wall is connected to the frame, floors and foundation.
summary.zh: 这面墙与框架、楼板和基础相连。

detail.en: The wall is one generic example of structural support, not a claim about every Singapore building. Response depends on ground conditions and vibration characteristics; height alone cannot rank safety. [S25, S63]
detail.zh: 这面墙只是结构支撑的通用例子，不代表每栋新加坡建筑。响应受地面条件和振动特性影响，不能只按高矮排列安全程度。[S25, S63]

label.zh: 模型中存在长波时的理论速度
